recommended_runtime_requirements: Require an explicit ready state and all model/preprocessing hashes before startup
Persist model version and input snapshot revision with each prediction
Reject mismatched encoder revisions, nonfinite inputs and missing required blocks
Compare fixed parity fixtures before model promotion
Use atomic work claims if deploying multiple scoring workers
Requeue updates newer than the captured input revision, not merely completion time
